title: A Multi-Layer Navigation System for Smart Wheelchairs with a Limited Input Interface
summary: In 360 trials with ten participants without disabilities, the full system completed 99.72% of tasks; no isolated causal effect of vision or clinical benefit is established. The real wheelchair study covers 360 trials by ten nondisabled participants; system-level result is confounded by differing priority policy and is not a clinical evaluation.
